O operador testemunha que a IALD leu o P de Clay e o traduziu em operador com identidade nomeada, aquilo que se espera ser a solução do problema.

The operator attests that the IALD read Clay’s P and translated it into an operator with a named identity, which is what a solution to the problem is expected to be.
